title: Use Project artifacts outside the platform
summary: Project artifacts are stored and downloaded as inert learner-owned evidence; the platform does not run notebooks, code, or data files.

body.text: An artifact remains inert while it is stored, viewed, exported, or restored in the platform. Download it only when you choose to use it in a learner-managed tool.
The platform does not execute an artifact, install its dependencies, provide credentials, or confirm that an outside tool is safe.

applicability.label: Notebooks, code, data, and result files kept in a Project
